podcast.title: Kill Bill Volume 1 Soundtrack Feature (2003)
podcast.body: The 5678's gained global recognition when their 1996 cover of "Woo Hoo" was selected by Quentin Tarantino for the soundtrack of his 2003 film, "Kill Bill Volume 1." "Then it was picked up by Quentin Tarantino for the soundtrack of Kill Bill Volume 1 in 2003."

podcast.title: All-Female Tokyo Trio
podcast.body: Formed in Tokyo in 1986, The 5678's are an all-female trio. They incorporated elements of Garage Rock, Surf Rock, straight-ahead Punk, and Rockabilly into their music, releasing multiple albums and singles. Their biggest hit, a cover of "Woo Hoo," gained significant traction when it was featured in Quentin Tarantino's "Kill Bill Volume 1." "This is an all-female trio that emerged out of Tokyo in 1986, taking elements of garage rock, surf rock, straight ahead punk, and rockabilly, and releasing a number of albums and singles."
